title: User-Computer Authentication Associations in Time
access_license: Public download; LANL waives copyright/related rights to extent possible
scale_schema: 9 continuous months; 708,304,516 successful authentication events; time,user,computer; 11,362 users; 22,284 computers
semantics_supported: Authentication event; temporal user-computer association; large-scale authentication graph
main_limitations: Successful events only; no explicit credential/session/authorization; anonymized IDs are not legal/human identity evidence

title: Login Data Set for Risk-Based Authentication
scale_schema: >33M login attempts; >3.3M users; timestamp success IP/geolocation ASN user-agent OS/browser/device-type RTT attack/account-takeover indicators
semantics_supported: Authentication attempt/result; account; device/context observations; risk labels
main_limitations: Synthetic feature values preserving selected real distributions/relations; not production-security ground truth

title: ID4D Global Dataset 2025
scale_schema: Country/national indicators through 2024; official ID coverage; digital-ID ownership/use/capability; remote authentication availability
semantics_supported: Government identity coverage; digital credential availability; remote authentication capability; system/lifecycle characteristics
main_limitations: Aggregate/national; no individual transactions; not a normative ontology source

title: Global Findex Database 2025 world microdata with ID4D module
access_license: World Bank Microdata Library; edited anonymized public-distribution dataset
scale_schema: 2024 microdata across 140+ economies; ID4D module plus connectivity/financial inclusion variables
semantics_supported: ID ownership/use; digital identity access/use; demographic/context variation
main_limitations: Self-report/survey semantics; sampling design applies; cannot imply technical assurance from ownership/use

title: Comprehensive Multi-Source Cyber-Security Events
access_license: Public research dataset; verify redistribution terms before packaging derived samples
scale_schema: 58 consecutive days; 1,648,275,307 events; 12,425 users; 17,684 computers; authentication DNS process flow and red-team events; authentication includes source/destination users/computers type logon orientation success/failure
semantics_supported: Authentication events with success/failure; Active Directory/controller context; source/destination representations; compromise ground truth
main_limitations: Cybersecurity dataset broader than identity; large 12GB compressed corpus; only identity-relevant slices should be used; do not model process/network fields as identity concepts

title: Behavior-based User Authentication Dataset
access_license: Record public; files restricted unless access granted
scale_schema: Behavioral/WiFi-enabled IoT authentication dataset associated with MobiHoc 2017 research
main_limitations: Restricted files and narrow behavioral-biometric scope; does not add broad digital-identity ontology coverage beyond Authentication

title: Pre-AttentiveGaze gaze-based authentication dataset
scale_schema: Gaze-based authentication interactions with technical validation
main_limitations: High-quality recent authentication dataset but narrow biometric modality; use only if Gate-D requires authenticator-modality diversity
